findings.title: missing_docs_workspace test does not pass --features flag
findings.evidence: The full_missing_docs_sweep_no_warnings_workspace_wide test spawns `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps` with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D missing_docs but does NOT pass any --features flag. Feature-gated `pub` items inside `#[cfg(feature = "testing")] pub mod testing` (and equivalent) are therefore NOT exercised by this gate. The §3.5j stable+MSRV clippy gate uses the explicit `--features benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing` spec; the missing-docs gate does not mirror it. Manual run with `--features testing` was also clean at HEAD, so this is not an active drift — it is a coverage-gap observation.
findings.disposition: DISAGREE-WITH-EXPLANATION — recording as OBSERVATION not finding because (a) the documented intent of `full_missing_docs_sweep_no_warnings_workspace_wide` (G20-B + phase-2-backlog §8.3) was the default-features sweep, (b) feature-gated `pub mod testing` items are covered by the §3.5j clippy gate which DOES run with the testing features, and (c) HEAD is clean under both spec variants. If R6 R2 wants to harden the gate, the fix is one-line: add `.arg("--features").arg("benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing")` to match the §3.5j spec. Not promoted to MINOR because the §3.5j clippy gate already catches missing-docs on the testing-feature surface via clippy's missing_docs lint propagation.
findings.destination: N/A — OBSERVATION only; not gating R6 R1 convergence.
